test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_orders(id UInt64, order_date Date) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY order_date
CREATE TABLE rf_line_items(order_id UInt64, amount UInt64, tax UInt64, discount UInt64) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY order_id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_orders SELECT number, toDate('2015-01-01') + intDiv(number, 10000) FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO rf_line_items SELECT intDiv(number, 3), number % 997, number % 31, number % 7 FROM numbers(60000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(l.amount), sum(l.tax), sum(l.discount) FROM rf_line_items AS l INNER JOIN rf_orders AS o ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN toDate('2015-01-01') AND toDate('2015-01-01') + 9) OR (o.order_date BETWEEN toDate('2015-01-01') + 1990 AND toDate('2015-01-01') + 1999) SETTINGS enable_join_runtime_filters_index_analysis = 1
